Enterprise-grade security and controls

Talk to an expert→

SOC 2 Type II. Independently audited controls for security, availability, and confidentiality.

GDPR. EU data-subject rights honored, with lawful-basis handling for personal data.

CCPA. California consumer privacy rights, including access and deletion requests.

HIPAA. Safeguards for protected health information, with a BAA available.

Zero data retention. Your queries and results are never stored or trained on.

Enterprise agreements. BAA discussions, DPA documentation, and custom data-security arrangements.
